item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Indira fills three cells in a row with numbers. A cell is a supercell when its number is greater than each immediate neighbour. She wants only the middle cell to be a supercell.

Which statement is correct?

options.A: The filling 9, 4, 2 works, because only the left cell is a supercell.
options.B: The filling 4, 9, 2 works, because only the middle cell is greater than each immediate neighbour.
options.C: Any filling where 9 appears is enough, because 9 is the largest number she wrote.
options.D: The filling 2, 4, 9 works, because only the right cell is a supercell.
